notes.title: Patch Notes:
notes.notes:
Patch Notes:

UI Fixes: Resolved issues with the UI at 640x480 resolution.
Shadows: Added more customization options for shadow settings.
Performance: Introduced an extra performance mode (game scene only).
Crafting Recipes:
Recipes are scattered across the map for discovery.
Added an additional location: the back of the first house where you spawn.

notes.title: patch notes 11/15/2024
notes.notes:
"EXTRA PERFORMANCE MODE" that you can trigger in gamescene settings. It should make the game extremely performant even on devices with mobile intel integrated graphics card as it lowers camera render distance to 10% and adds dense fog to cover for it. 

changed material of characters
changed some colliders
changed difficulty names
fixed scaling issues on ultra wide screens
grappling gun can no longer hit thorugh walls
